pool.text: City founded by Captain Alonso de Mendoza as Nuestra Señora de La Paz.
Juan Gutierrez Paniagua designed the urban plan with plazas and cathedral.
Aymara leader Túpac Katari laid six‑month siege to La Paz.
Pedro Domingo Murillo sparked independence revolution on 16 July.
Pedro Domingo Murillo was executed at Plaza de los Españoles.
City renamed La Paz de Ayacucho after republican victory at Ayacucho.
Metropolitan Cathedral constructed beside Presidential Palace on Murillo Square.
La Paz became de facto seat of Bolivia's national government.
Tin generated a third of national revenue and over half of customs.
Joined Union of Ibero‑American Capital Cities on 12 October.
Became member of Merco Ciudades, network of Mercosur cities.
Chacaltaya glacier near El Alto disappeared completely.
Mi Teleférico aerial cable‑car system opened for urban transit.
City's cultural practices entered UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list.
President Evo Morales suggested renaming city to Chuquiago Marka.
